tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag bzhugs so/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cigaswasti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir shākya'i btsun pa dpal ldan don 'grub kyis rang nyid kyi dad pa dang / gzhan rkyen gyi bskul ba la brten nas/ yig rigs 'ga' zhig bris pa rnams/ tho yig tu btab pa la/ thog mar rje btsun brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ bla ma de nyid kyi spyan sngar 'bul ba'i yan lag bdun pa/ rje bla ma dam pa mus chen la bstod pa/ yang de nyid la bstod pa/ rje bla ma kun dga' bkris la bstod pa/ rje ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje la bstod pa/ rje kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa/ 'khon ston kun dga' blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad/ dbu ma lugs kyi byang sems sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs/ gshed dmar spros med kyi brgyud 'debs/ 'jig byed rnal 'byor bzhi khrid kyi brgyud 'debs/ 'byung 'dul rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi brgyud 'debs/ mgon po dpal bzang gis zhus pa'i bla ma rgyang 'bod/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don/ de'i 'grel pa/ thub pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad smon lam dang bcas pa/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo rab bstod pa/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo la bstod pa shlau ka gcig rje btsun ma sgrol ma la 'jigs pa bcu drug gi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i mngon rtogs/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang rdzas sbyor/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang 'khrus chog thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshom bu lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ de'i 'pho ba/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang / phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs/

de'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ seng ge sgra'i bsnyen thabs/ 'jigs byed la brten pa'i char 'bebs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung ngag gi bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang gi gsal byed/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan gyi sngon 'gro'i bshad pa/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi bsdus don/ rig gsum dbang gi spyi'i tho yig 'phags pa brgyad stong pa la na bza' sna lnga phul ba'i tshigs bcad lnga/ chos gtam skyon tshang yul don/ bar do'i chos bshad/ bsngo ba'i yon bshad/ dge bsnyen spyod pa bkra shis kyi zhus pa'i rjes gnang / 'khrus chog thugs rje chen po dmar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ de'i 'pho ba/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ bsngo ba bsdus pa'i tshigs bcad/ rgya rong pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis dris lan/ chos rje ngag dbang chos grags kyis dris lan rtsa ba/ de'i 'grel pa/ rab 'byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis dris lan/ rab 'byams pa legs pa chos 'phel gyis dris lan/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i chos skor gyi gsal byed/ rang la bstod pa shlau ka gcig rang la bstod pa dad ldan dga' byed/ dge slong bkra shis dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i bla ma gsum gyi bstod pa shlau ka re re/ khams ston mgon po dpal bzang la phul ba'i yi ge chos srung gle lung lha mo la snyan dar phul ba'i tshigs bcad/ mgon po legs ldan mched gsum gyi gtor chog de'i rjes gnang rnams yod/ maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 ngor mkhan po dpal ldan don grub/ dpal ldan don grub kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
